headline: Completed the hexagonal ports migration for the xtask crate
day_narrative: Refactored the xtask crate to use hexagonal architecture with Executor and GitReader ports. This enhances modularity and testing capabilities, improving the developer experience.

goals.title: Shipped the xtask hexagonal ports refactor
goals.label: xtask hexagonal ports
goals.summary: The xtask crate now uses hexagonal architecture with proper port and adapter patterns.

tasks.title: Refactor the executor and git reader ports

tasks.title: Mirror CI workflows locally
tasks.what_got_done: Developed ci_local modules to mirror GitHub Actions workflows.

tasks.title: Implement tests for the new ci_local modules
tasks.what_got_done: Created unit tests for each new ci_local job in xtask.

tasks.title: Enhance observability in the CI pipeline
tasks.what_got_done: Updated CI workflows for better logging and error capture.
